theme: make-style rebuild delta KEEPNEWER KEEPOLDER FRESH KEEPSTALE stamp

tests.name: stamp_newer
tests.cmd: KEEPNEWER vs build.out → also+new (drop old) ref_ok=1

tests.name: touchref_newer_none
tests.cmd: TOUCH stamp then newer REQUIRE exit 2

weaknesses.title: FRESH/KEEPSTALE reject numeric vars — need STR shuttle
weaknesses.detail: Age limit accepts TK_NUM literal or string arg only. SYS FRESH bag AGE with num AGE fails parse (SYS FRESH bag max_age_sec). Agents must SYS STR AGE first. THRESHKV accepts nums; inconsistent.
weaknesses.repro: LET AGE=60; SYS FRESH paths AGE → fail; STR then FRESH ok

weaknesses.title: KEEPNEWER missing ref keeps all; KEEPOLDER missing keeps none
weaknesses.detail: Asymmetric make-style: missing stamp = rebuild everything for NEWER, but OLDER empties. Easy to mis-gate backup-older-than-checkpoint vs rebuild-all.
weaknesses.repro: KEEPNEWER bag miss → all exist; KEEPOLDER bag miss → empty

weaknesses.title: FRESH max_age=0 is only age==0 not inclusive window
weaknesses.detail: Just-touched files only; any clock tick drops them. No ms-resolution; tests race on slow hosts.

weaknesses.title: No mtime equality mode (newer-or-equal / older-or-equal)
weaknesses.detail: KEEPNEWER is strict >; same mtime sources not rebuilt. Touch-equal race can skip rebuild.
weaknesses.repro: source mtime == stamp → not in KEEPNEWER

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: DELTA full paths collapse into one string.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: STAMP.txt and DELTA last line without $ on cat -A.

weaknesses.title: TOUCH cannot set historical mtime for fixtures
weaknesses.detail: Stamp/source age spread needs host sleep or touch -d.

weaknesses.title: FRESH/KEEPSTALE drop missing paths silently (no MISS count in path form)
weaknesses.detail: Ghost paths disappear into DROP; no parallel MISS bag. KEEPNEWER_DROP mixes older+missing+ghost.
weaknesses.repro: FRESH bag_with_ghost → ghost in DROP not separate

workarounds: Always SYS STR age_var before FRESH/KEEPSTALE
Check KEEPNEWER_REF_OK before treating empty as up-to-date
Missing stamp: use newer for rebuild-all; do not use older
language_gaps: Per-path miss markers distinct from older-drop
issues_faced: Hit W1 immediately: FRESH AGE num var parse fail — worked around with STR
